128347.overview: Ugh is a caveman who must prepare himself for the oncoming ice age. To survive, he must gather food, which comes in the shape of the eggs of the local pterodactyl, "Pterry". Armed with only a spear, Ugh must go from his cave to the top of the mountain and rob Pterry's nest. Pterry, flying at the top of the screen, defends his nest by dropping rocks. The scent of human flesh also brings out the local tyrannosaurus rex, who hunts Ugh back and forth on the mountain paths. Ugh can use his spear to kill either beast, but the spear must be used carefully, since only one can be carried. Ugh must also drop the spear in order to be able to carry the pterodactyl eggs back to his cave. Once 8000 points have been collected then Ugh goes to a new screen with a different layout of paths. There are three skill levels (A, B, C) that can be selected at the start of the game.

155384.overview:
Your task as a fleet commander is to escort a convoy from one end of the map to the other within a set time limit, with at least half the convoy vessels surviving the U-boat wolfpack hiding in the depths. The fleet commander has six destroyers for protecting the convoy and clearing the sea of submarines. The ships are equipped with sonar to discover the submarines and a number of depth charges and torpedoes to destroy them with. Only a limited amount of moves may be made during each turn.

A second player may join the game, playing as the submarine commander. Submarines may lay at the sea bottom (invisible to sonar), periscope level (for firing torpedoes), or in plain sight above the surface. At the surface level, the surface ships may ram the submarines, thereby saving precious munitions.

175693.overview:
In UXB the player is given the task of defusing an old unexploded war-time bomb. The game is menu based and played with keyboard. First the player has to choose the right items from his toolkit. Due to limited space in the vicinity of the bomb he can only carry six of these twelve items: small spanner, copper hammer, cold chisel, special fluid, sidecutters, stethoscope, socket set, pliers, hydraulic jack, special spanner, insulating tape and small screwdriver. If the player picks more than six items the bomb will go off right away. There is no way to dump an item so it's necessary to pick the right ones from the start. Before starting to work, the bomb can be examined from three views: side, nose and hatch.

When working on the bomb the player is presented with a menu of five options (for example move bomb or unscrew nosecap). The player has to pick the right option and then the right tool. Picking the wrong combination leads to the bomb going off while picking the right one leads to the player advancing to the next menu (with new options) and everything repeats until the bomb has been defused. If stuck the player can type HELP to get a hint on how to proceed. When the bomb goes off the player is given the choice to restart from the last move or from the beginning.

175694.overview: Your aim is to zap the Ultrapede before it can reach you. Blast part of its body and the remaining sections wind their way downwards along separate paths bouncing off of the mushrooms as they go. Look out for Sid the spider who will appear every now and again to crash into you, and be attentive to Brian who will suddenly arrive dropping his deadly fleas on you and create yet more mushrooms!!

175695.overview: You are standing in a market with some money and your quest is to buy items before leaving the market into the big bad world to make more money and return back to the market. You will encounter various locations like jungle, swamp and desert as well as alligators, bandits pythons etc and these will try to decrease your strength until you die. The screen has text to describe each location, how much money you have and your strength, and you type in commands with the keyboard to interact with your surroundings.

446526.overview: After discovering the entrance to an underground village, the player has been captured by its guardians. The player is now locked in an iron cage, suspended by a chain above a dark pit. The player is tasked with escaping the underground city to freedom. The layer explores labyrinths, dangerous passageways, and old caves.
